items.title: Turrón by Plazo expands card-based BNPL offering in Spain
items.why: Pairing BNPL with experience gift providers creates a funded partnership template worth testing for premium card experience benefits.
items.summary_ai: Plazo's card-based BNPL product Turrón signed a partnership with Wonderbox, a Spanish experience gift provider.
